deploy-bot: :rocket: Staging deploy started
deploy-bot: env=staging tag=release-2026-03-18-rc2 commit=a1b2c3d summary=embed+reranker tweak initiator=@oliver.releases change-window=02:00-03:00 UTC
oliver.releases: quick heads-up: release notes at https://redwood.internal/releases/2026-03-18-rc2 :page_with_curl:
lucy.product: noted. I'll run the canary prompt set after smoke.
marco.eng: kicking off smoke now — running `./scripts/smoke.sh --env staging --tag release-2026-03-18-rc2`
taylor.sre: watching service p95, alert if >400ms sustained 3m. also watching error-rate :eyes:
deploy-bot: traffic-shift: 0% -> 10% (gradual). canary-instance ids: [i-stg-12, i-stg-13]
qa-bot: smoke tests: embedding pipeline OK, basic chat flows OK, reranker quick-check failing 1/12 :warning:
marco.eng: link to failing test logs: https://logs.redwood.internal/staging/2026-03-18-rc2/summary.log
marco.eng: failing repro snippet:
```
curl -X POST https://staging.api.redwood/v1/rerank -d '{"q":"price of widgets","candidates":[...]}'
# response: top result missing relevance score, backend 502 transient
```
taylor.sre: we should hold traffic shift at 10% until reranker check passes. if error-rate >1% revert plan ready.
oliver.releases: can we pin model variant for reranker to previous-stable while we investigate? that avoids full rollback.
marco.eng: yes we can pin the reranker variant to tag `reranker@2026-03-17-stable` via runtime pin. command:
```
reda runtime pin --service reranker --env staging --variant reranker@2026-03-17-stable
```
lucy.product: +1 from product. prefer pin over full rollback if it fixes tests.
deploy-bot: pin request executed by @marco.eng — reranker pinned to reranker@2026-03-17-stable. verifying...
qa-bot: re-running failing check now.
qa-bot: reranker check -> PASS (0/12 fail). all smoke tests green :white_check_mark:
taylor.sre: observing p95 and error-rate: p95 steady ~120ms, error-rate <0.1%. safe to continue ramp.
deploy-bot: traffic-shift: 10% -> 50% (gradual). monitoring 15m.
oliver.releases: note for release notes: include that reranker variant was pinned during early ramp, and we will follow up in postmortem if needed.
marco.eng: opening an issue to track reranker regression: https://github.com/redwood/repo/issues/4321
deploy-bot: staging deploy completed: tag=release-2026-03-18-rc2 status=partial (reranker pinned) commit=a1b2c3d duration=9m
lucy.product: thanks team :tada:
marco.eng: follow-up tasks: investigate upstream reranker change, test harness gap, and decide if we roll forward with fix or revert full stack in next window.
oliver.releases: will coordinate canary -> dedicated rollout once reranker root cause confirmed.
